# Charles Barton

> Product, AI and digital transformation executive based in Dubai, UAE. Helps businesses grow from one stage to the next by turning strategy into products customers adopt, and products into commercial results.

## Leadership impact
- SAP Commerce Cloud (hybris and SAP, Munich, 2011 to 2022): part of the leadership that grew SAP's cloud commerce business from launch to $400M+ revenue; 3,000+ brands; $600B+ annual customer sales on the platform; AI personalization adopted by 1,000+ enterprises. Brands include Carrefour, Mercedes-Benz, Apple, Nestlé and H&M.
- EGYM (Senior Director of Product, Munich and Dubai, 2022 to 2026): unified hardware and digital product businesses into one portfolio, team and operating model; AI in production for 10M+ people; $400M+ revenue; led product into the $7.5B merger with Playlist.
- Sana Commerce (VP of Product, executive team, Dubai, 2026): strategy for a next B2B platform built for agentic commerce, serving 800+ manufacturers and distributors.

## How he leads
1. Customer first, then work backwards.
2. Start with business outcomes.
3. Empowered teams and coaching.
4. Choosing what to build with AI is the strategy.
Customer first. Outcomes as the measure. Empowered teams as the engine. AI as the multiplier.

## Focus
Omnichannel commerce, agentic commerce, AI transformation, product operating models.
